predecessors.name: Moghulistan
predecessors.text: Cliopatria's Moghulistan shape of 1516, the Moghul lands west of the Tarim: 'western Moghulistan (the area of modern Kyrgyzstan)' and the Zhetysu, the part Cliopatria does not give to Eastern…

successors.name: Kyrgyz Khanate
successors.text: the Tian Shan lands that 'were gradually lost to Kyrgyz tribes' (Moghulistan page)

ledger.x: 1519: Cliopatria opens Western Moghulistan, the Moghul lands of Zhetysu and the Tian Shan, when its Moghulistan row ends.
1533: Abdurashid Khan begins the struggle for western Moghulistan.
1565: the struggle ends with Abdurashid's reign.
1565: the Moghuls are 'largely restricted to possession of the Tarim Basin' and western Moghulistan ends.

wars.name: Kyrgyz revolt against the Moghuls
wars.outcome: The Kyrgyz tribes, led by Tagai Biy, rebelled against the Moghuls and 'by 1510-11 ... had effectively driven out the Moghuls'; Sultan Said's attempt in 1526-27 to return them to subjugation failed.

wars.name: Abdurashid Khan's struggle with the Kazakhs for western Moghulistan
wars.outcome: No decisive result is given: Abdurashid 'fought for control of (western) Moghulistan against the Kirghiz-Kazakhs of the Great Horde' and afterwards the Moghuls were 'largely restricted to possession of the Tarim Basin'.

certainty.note: A claim over mountain and steppe country whose frontiers no page opened describes; the Kyrgyz held much of it after 1510-11.
